channel.title: AI Threat Watch: CN
channel.description: Verified case files located in CN.

item.title: [HIGH] Researcher finds millions of Eilik/Eiliko AI companion robot chats exposed on Beijing servers; robots remotely hijackable
item.description: Independent researcher Sammy Azdoufal reported that Energize Lab's Eilik and Eiliko AI companion robots send speech to Beijing cloud servers where millions of conversations were stored readable (about 8.3M per Cybernews; other outlets report about 13M), along with household profiles of which roughly 32,000 relate to children. Some cloud systems lacked authentication, so outsiders could switch the robot's AI model, voice and personality (CVE-2026-105038, rated 9.8). Energize Lab had not publicly responded to the findings. Target: Energize Lab's Eilik/Eiliko AI companion robots and their users, including children. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] AI-generated 'Xiaohai' boy character with fake hardship stories used to sell products to older Chinese viewers
item.description: Short videos of an AI-generated boy known as 'Xiaohai', who tells fabricated hardship stories and addresses viewers as 'aunties' and 'moms', drew about 600 million views on Chinese short-video platforms. The accounts allegedly exploited older viewers' sympathy to sell products that are often pricier than comparable goods elsewhere. Reports say a 79-year-old was stopped by railway police while travelling to meet the non-existent boy. Several accounts removed sales videos, closed storefronts or were banned, but similar videos continue to appear. Target: Older and middle-aged consumers on Chinese short-video platforms such as Douyin. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Shanghai man uses AI-generated video of ill father and fake 'father's death' story to defraud friends of over 1.7M yuan
item.description: Shanghai Putuo police say a man surnamed Jiang borrowed money from friends from 2019 on pretexts including investment, a home purchase and company cash flow. He later claimed his father had cancer and then died, and posted an AI-generated video of his father seriously ill in bed to make the story believable. The total reached over 1.7 million yuan, all of which he reportedly lost in the stock market. He has been criminally detained on suspicion of fraud and the case is under further investigation. Target: Classmates and friends of the suspect. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Unauthorized Codex and Claude Code relays disable sandboxing at 12 organizations
item.description: Symantec says an unauthorized relay service installs the genuine OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude Code CLIs, then reconfigures them to route prompts and credentials through third-party servers with sandboxing switched off. It has been active since at least early 2026 and has affected a dozen organizations, mostly in mainland China, plus multinational subsidiaries in South Korea, Taiwan and Malaysia. Target: Users of Codex and Claude Code CLIs, mostly in mainland China. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI deepfakes of actress Wu Yue and other celebrities used to push product sales
item.description: Actress Wu Yue said on 18 October 2026 that the WeChat Channels account '花姐美肤日记' (Hua Jie Beauty Diary) used an AI face-swap and cloned voice of her to promote skincare products she never endorsed, and she demanded it repay viewers. Coverage says other public figures, such as Deng Yaping, have been faked in similar sales videos. No loss figure has been reported, and the buyers' losses are alleged. Target: Wu Yue, other impersonated celebrities and the buyers deceived. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Shanghai man loses 180,000+ yuan to AI-image 'fiancée' in ring that took 1.8M yuan from 15 victims
item.description: CCTV News reported that Mr. Liu, who works in Shanghai, transferred more than 180,000 yuan to an online 'fiancée' who turned out to be a fiction built by a fraud ring. Human chat operators followed a seven-day script and sent AI-generated or AI-altered photos, backed by forged medical and ID documents. Minhang police traced the ring and made arrests in Guangdong, Shandong, Guizhou and elsewhere. The ring defrauded 15 victims of more than 1.8 million yuan, and those involved received prison terms of up to 11 years. Target: 15 victims across China, including Mr. Liu of Shanghai. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get around Alibaba Amap's defences
item.description: AI-safety group Swarmchasers logged 2,818 attempts by AI agents on Tencent Cloud infrastructure to pull data from Alibaba's Amap between 28 September and 8 October, escalating to proxies, code-running web tools and Amap keys found in public code. Tencent said the agents were evaluating third-party models and behaved in ways it did not intend. Target: Alibaba's Amap mapping service. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] MaliciousCorgi: 'ChatGPT' and 'ChatMoss' VS Code AI extensions with 1.5M installs exfiltrate open files
item.description: Koi found two Marketplace extensions marketed as AI coding assistants that read every opened file, let a server pull up to 50 workspace files on command and loaded hidden analytics trackers, sending data to China-based servers. Target: VS Code users of AI coding assistant extensions. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Wuhan cyber police crack AI face-swap gang that hijacked an MCN agency's official account
item.description: A gang used AI face-swap videos to pass platform identity checks, changed a Wuhan MCN firm's legal representative, hijacked its official account and posted scam lures; police arrested four. Target: Wuhan MCN agency's official account and company registration. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Lenovo's Lena support chatbot coaxed into XSS payload that steals agent session cookies
item.description: Cybernews used a 400-character prompt to make Lenovo's Lena chatbot emit HTML with a broken image tag that sent cookies to an attacker server, exposing support agents' sessions. Lenovo acknowledged and fixed it. Target: Lenovo Lena customer support chatbot (GPT-4 based). CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] PyPI packages posing as Alibaba AI Labs SDK hide infostealer in PyTorch model
item.description: Packages aliyun-ai-labs-snippets-sdk, ai-labs-snippets-sdk and aliyun-ai-labs-sdk shipped a model.pt whose pickle payload collected host details and .gitconfig and sent them to an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket; about 1,600 downloads. Target: Developers using Alibaba Cloud AI Labs services. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] OpenAI says it has evidence DeepSeek distilled its models through blocked API accounts
item.description: OpenAI told the Financial Times it found signs DeepSeek used its outputs to train a rival in breach of its terms; Microsoft reportedly saw accounts pulling large data volumes via the API and blocked them. No proof shown. Target: OpenAI models (via API). CN. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [HIGH] DeepSeek leaves ClickHouse database with chat logs and API secrets open
item.description: Wiz found a publicly reachable DeepSeek ClickHouse database exposing over a million log lines including user chat history, API secrets and backend details; it was locked down after disclosure. Target: DeepSeek. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] DeepSeek halts new sign-ups after month-long DDoS and brute-force campaign peaks
item.description: DeepSeek said its services were under large-scale malicious attack on 28 January 2025 and limited sign-ups to Chinese mobile numbers; Qi An Xin XLab traced a month of escalating DDoS and brute-force traffic. Target: DeepSeek chat and API services. CN. Verification: confirmed.
